info.plain:
- CI: Allow the GitHub Actions bot to make release PRs - [#34076](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/pull/34076), thanks @Sidnioulz!
- Test: Fix clearing mocks in Vitest - [#34078](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/pull/34078), thanks @Sidnioulz!
- Core: Fix event source URL based on refId when multiple iframes share the same origin - [#34105](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/pull/34105), thanks @ghengeveld!
- UI: Make TagsFilter state persistent - [#33374](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/pull/33374), thanks @Sidnioulz!
- A11y: Make resize handles for addon panel and sidebar accessible - [#33980](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/pull/33980), thanks @Sidnioulz!
- Maintenance: Use std-env for AI agent detection in telemetry - [#34114](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/pull/34114), thanks @valentinpalkovic!
- Addon-Vitest: Make Playwright --with-deps platform-aware to avoid sudo prompt on Linux - [#34121](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/pull/34121), thanks @valentinpalkovic!
- Addon-docs: Restore docs.components overrides for doc blocks - [#34111](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/pull/34111), thanks @JReinhold!
- Maintenance: Support vite-plugin-svelte7 which supports Vite 8 - [#34115](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/pull/34115), thanks @valentinpalkovic!
- Core: Fix handling complex viewport sizes - [#33615](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/pull/33615), thanks @ghengeveld!
- Core: Fix iframe reference for composed Storybook on a subpath - [#34100](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/pull/34100), thanks @ghengeveld!
- Manifest: Rename experimentalComponentsManifest → componentsManifest, default to true - [#33974](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/pull/33974), thanks @JReinhold!
- Manifests: Fix Attached MDX causing wrong component entries - [#34101](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/pull/34101), thanks @JReinhold!
- Vue3-Vite: Allow paths in docgen tsconfig option - [#32310](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/pull/32310), thanks @Thomaash!
- Next.js: Move image configuration from FrameworkOptions to parameters - [#32639](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/pull/32639), thanks @y-hsgw!
- Docs: Make CSS ordering in DocsContainer more predictable - [#34015](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/pull/34015), thanks @Sidnioulz!
- Maintenance: Install NX MCP server - [#33234](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/pull/33234), thanks @valentinpalkovic!
- Documentation: Add CLAUDE.md and docs for AI coding assistants - [#33568](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/pull/33568), thanks @kasperpeulen!
- Build: Fix CI issues for expo and sveltekit sandboxes - [#34135](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/pull/34135), thanks @yannbf!
- Angular: Update Node CI executors to support Angular prerelease Node.js min version - [#34112](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/pull/34112), thanks @Sidnioulz!
- SvelteKit: Fix template stories using runes mode - [#34128](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/pull/34128), thanks @JReinhold!
- Build: Install Husky hooks in fresh worktrees - [#34126](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/pull/34126), thanks @kasperpeulen!
- Docs: Add sidebarOnboardingChecklist feature and feature defaults - [#34103](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/pull/34103), thanks @ghengeveld!
